## Grids

- Grids are simpler
- Pre-existing grids:
  - 1 km x 1 km Military Grid Reference System (MGRS)
- Construct your own. Two examples:
  - 100 M x 100 M example
  - 0.01 Longitude x 0.01 Latitude 

::: {.notes}
- State Farm uses a longitude / latitude grid. Virginia example: SFMA-131879778
- Stillwater Insurance Company in Mississippi uses 250 m x 250 m grid for Hurricane (FDLY-131846574)
- Metromile Insurance (Lemonade) uses 200 m x 200 m grids in Ohio (MOCC-133615692)
- For some purposes, the grid can change resolutions, for example, documentation from a cat modeling vendor in filings uses more granlarity in Dallas and Oklahoma City than in rural areas nearby (AMMH-134880342)
:::
